description: Scans .ts and .html files (or a directory) and returns a MARKDOWN REPORT combining findings, complexity, a suggested file order, the constructs present with their recipe names, and a warning for any version-sensitive recipe involved. Returns the report as a string — it does NOT write a file; you decide whether to save it. Read-only: this tool never modifies your files.

path.description: Absolute path to a .ts file or a directory to scan recursively.

name: get_migration_report
title: Generate a Signal Forms migration report
